headline: Not only in the USA. AI stocks are also plunging in China. Drop of 1.7 trillion dollars.
summary: Chinese companies linked to artificial intelligence have lost a combined $1.7 trillion in market value since the end of June, according to investing.com. Investors cite high valuations, US export restrictions and weaker sector outlook.
why: AI-linked firms are a major growth theme in Chinese equities, and their valuations are sensitive to export controls on advanced chips and technology. Sharp sector sell-offs can weigh on China's broader tech index.
why_moved: Investors are worried about high valuations, US export restrictions and a weaker sector outlook, according to the report.
original_headline: Nie tylko w USA. Akcje AI pikują także w Chinach. Spadek o 1,7 bln dol.
